nativeCoverage: A second disposal preserves the native R2 object version.
The first Worker runtime is disposed before retrying through a replacement runtime.
Concurrent management callers converge on the deletion marker.
Expired, readonly and wrong-sandbox capabilities are rejected.
Reads remain unavailable and the administrator cannot reuse the disposed ID.
limitations: Disposal does not instantly terminate guest CPU already executing.
Live mutations competing with disposal may return a conflict.
Remote proof uses the Effect HTTP SDK; remote Minutei RPC remains unverified.
The local benchmark overlapped the test suite and establishes no performance comparison.
